# Image fixtures

`progressive-420-dri.jpg` is the minimal 16 × 16 pixel fixture used by the
`zune-jpeg` 0.5.15 decoder to cover progressive YCbCr 4:2:0 JPEG with restart
markers. The file was incorporated unchanged from the
`test_progressive_dri_420_color` test under the package's MIT or Apache-2.0
licenses.
